name: 刻板过渡词与语篇框架标记侦测 (Discourse Markers)
description: 分析语篇标记（如“此外”、“而且”、“因此”）的频率、多样性和结构性分布位置。AI 极度依赖一套狭窄、八股文式的正式过渡词库，像缝纫机一样把段落机械地拼接在一起。
algorithm: 语篇连词提取与 Jensen-Shannon 散度测算
mechanism: Large Language Models are optimized to produce text that is structurally sound, logical, and easy to follow. A major side effect of this optimization is the over-reliance on explicit cohesive devices—specifically, formal discourse markers. When transitioning between ideas or paragraphs, AI models disproportionately favor a rigid, almost academic vocabulary: 'Additionally', 'Furthermore', 'Moreover', 'However', and famously, 'In conclusion'. They also tend to place these markers exclusively at the very beginning of sentences (sentence-initial position). Human writers, by contrast, use a much wider variety of transitional strategies, frequently embedding markers in the middle of sentences (sentence-medial) or relying on implicit logical flow without needing a signpost word for every new thought. This method scans the text against a comprehensive lexicon of 150+ discourse markers, tracking both their frequency per sentence and their positional distribution. It then uses Jensen-Shannon divergence to compare this profile against known baselines for human writing. A text that is rigidly held together by a repetitive scaffold of 'Firstly', 'Secondly', 'Furthermore', and 'Finally' exhibits a strong AI signature.
useCase: 专治八股文式的各类报告、水军软文和假冒论文，在这些文章中，段落之间的转折和承接让人感到极其僵硬、做作或过度“拿腔拿调”（这些词被网友戏称为“AI 味起手式”）。
strengths:
• 能够一针见血地扒掉 LLM 默认最爱使用的“总-分-总（五段论）”八股文底裤。
• 捕捉的是超越单一词汇的高频宏观文本组织架构（Organization patterns）规律。
• 极其直观，容易给用户解释定罪理由，因为像“Furthermore（此外）”这种词已经被全球公认为识别 AI 写作的热门梗（Meme）。
limitations:
• 严重死锁于文本的具体语种和题材（例如：顶刊的人类学术论文本身就会比普通博客用更多的正式连词，容易引发误报）。
• 防御壁垒较薄：只要狡猾的提示词工程师直接下令“禁止使用此外、首先、总而言之等过渡词”，探针威力就会迅速衰减。
• 极其依赖人工投喂：必须为各个语种分别极其精细地梳理、定制和维护一套专属的语篇标记分类字典。
parameters:
雷达切片: 坐标抽取 (句首/句中/句尾) & 衔接标记符词典全息映射
定罪量表: 归一化连词密爆频率 & 偏离人类基线之 Jensen-Shannon 散度
行刑判决: 0-100 衔接僵死度 (八股文连贯框架) 定罪分数
accuracy: 中等到高爆破率 — 75-85%。像是一把极度敏锐的手术刀，切开 AI 伪装的表皮，直接暴露出它为了模拟人类逻辑流而强行搭建的丑陋算法脚手架。

references.title: Kumarage, T. et al. (2023). Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines. arXiv.
Halliday, M. A. K. & Hasan, R. (1976). Cohesion in English. Longman.
